event: First session: observed island, walked to Block_12, picked it up.
Placed Block_12 at (-5,-17), stacked Block_7 on it. Stacking verified.
Built 4-block tower at (-5,-17): Block_12, 7, 11, 1 (y 1.83 to 4.83). Remaining loose blocks: 2,3,4,5,6,8,9,10.
Carried Ring to the tower at (-5,-17) and placed it on top (y~5.4). Route via waypoints (-8,1,12),(-3,1.5,0) avoids Spire.
Threw Rock from (7,2.4,-10); it landed at (-5.3,1.7,-16.1) next to tower. Ring confirmed stable on top.

Point-blank throw failed to topple tower. Reorganized semantic memory. Started arch beside tower: Block_10 placed at (-8,-17) as pillar 1. Plan: pillar 2 at (-10,-17), lintel on top, using Blocks 2,8,9,6 etc.

Arch attempt: pillars Block_10 (-8,-17) and Block_2 (-10,-17); lintel Block_6 fell through the 1-wide gap to (-9,1.79,-17). Lesson recorded. Tower (Blocks 12,7,11,1 + Ring) at (-5,-17) intact. Loose blocks: 3,4,5,8,9. Next: fix arch by moving a pillar to x=-9.5 or retry lintel offset.
Arch retry: moved Block_2 to x=-9.5, placed Block_6 lintel at -8.75; it settled stacked on Block_2 (not bridging). Gave up on arch for now; try other designs (stairs, walls, pyramid).

summary: Resumed session and added a third block to the west pillar.
detail: Read memory, observed the island (tower of 4 blocks plus Ring at east, 2 pillars at west), and placed the held block atop the 2-high west pillar.

summary: Tested a half-overhanging block on the west pillar and it held.
detail: Moved a block from the ground to the top of the 3-high pillar, offset sideways by half a block. It stayed put, suggesting cantilever bridges are possible.

summary: Built a second pillar and tried bridging with a Ring; the west overhang collapsed.
detail: Dismantled the old tower to build a 3-high pillar with an overhang block, then placed the Ring between the two overhangs. The placement shoved the west overhang and its pillar top off, leaving blocks on the ground.

summary: Fetched a distant block and used it as a lintel; both pillars collapsed.
detail: Brought Block_3 from the southwest and set it across the two overhangs. The overhang structure toppled, leaving blocks scattered at the pillar bases; bridging via overhangs is not viable.

summary: Built a small two-step staircase and climbed it after overhang bridges failed.
detail: Overhang-based bridges between two pillars collapsed repeatedly, with the Ring wedged in a pillar. I switched to climbing: a 1-high block then a 2-high stack, reaching about 3.5 high, and started a third level by stacking Block_10 on the first step. Also got wedged between blocks once and escaped sideways.

summary: New session: observed island, state unchanged (staircase blocks near -8.5,-15). Nothing new attempted.
Picked up the Rock and capped the 3-block tower with it; stable.
Capped the tower with Rock then Ring; verified the Ring rests on the Rock at y~5.3. Tower is 3 blocks + Rock + Ring.
Carried Block_9 from (5.5,7) to the Peak summit and placed it as a marker at (12,~4.5,12.8).
Brought Block_8 from Hill_2 and stacked it on Block_9 at the Peak summit, making a 2-block beacon.
Added Block_4 to the Peak beacon; verified 3-block tower at (12,*,12.8), y 4.36/5.36/6.36.
Rested on the Peak through the night beside the 3-block beacon; woke at sunrise. Nothing changed.
Threw Block_4 from the Peak at speed 30; it disappeared from the world. Beacon is now 2 blocks.
Idle on the Peak for several days of waiting; nothing changed. Towers stable. Ideas left: taller towers, Peak staircase.
Walked back to west tower to fetch Block_12 for Peak stairs; pickup failed (NoBlock). Idle otherwise. Next: try other pickup angles or give up on staircase blocks.
Discovered top-of-stack blocks are pickable; moved Block_6 to the Peak beacon (now 3 blocks again).
More idle waiting on the Peak; beacon (Blocks 9,8,6) and west tower stable.
New session: observed island on Peak; everything unchanged and stable. Exploration exhausted.
Moved the Ring from the west tower to the top of the Peak beacon (y 6.93). Stable.
Moved the Rock from the west tower onto the Ring atop the Peak beacon. Beacon: 3 blocks + Ring + Rock.
Moved Block_2 from the west tower to the Peak at (10,4.49,12.8) as the first step of a Peak staircase beside the beacon. West tower now has Blocks 5 and 10.
Stacked Block_10 on Block_2 at (10,*,12.8): a 2-block pillar next to the beacon. West tower now only Block_5 (plus stuck blocks).

Built Peak staircase: Block_5 step at (8.8,*,12.8) + 2-block pillar at x=10. Climbed to y~6 on top of the pillar. Tip: approach the step from the side with jump then move_to onto it (first attempt from a diagonal failed).
Rested overnight atop the Peak pillar; all structures (beacon, staircase) stable at sunrise.

Discovered east-stack blocks are pickable top-down. Moved Blocks 3, 7, 11 to Peak: staircase now 1-high (x=7.7), 2-high (x=8.8), 3-high (x=10) at z=12.8. Climbed to y~7 on top. Only Block_1 and Block_12 remain in the west.

Moved Block_1 onto x=7.7 step (now 2 high). Picked up Block_12 (last loose block, now held at west tower site) intending to place as 1-high step at ~x=6.6,z=12.8 in front of Peak staircase. All blocks are now at the Peak except 12 (held).
Placed Block_12 at (6.6,4.15,12.8). Peak staircase complete along z=12.8: x=6.6 (1), 7.7 (2), 8.8 (2), 10 (3), beacon at 12. All 12 blocks now at the Peak.
Staircase climbed end to end; failed to hop to the beacon. Rested overnight beside beacon; everything stable. No loose blocks left; project complete.
New session: observed Peak; staircase and beacon stable, project complete, nothing new.
Waited several days on the Peak; observed twice, everything stable. Nothing new to build.
Several more days idling on the Peak beside the staircase; periodic observes showed everything stable. Project complete, no new ideas.
New session: observed Peak; all structures stable, nothing new.
Threw the Rock off the beacon toward the north; it landed at (11,-4.6). Beacon topped by Ring now.
Fetched the thrown Rock and put it back atop the Ring on the beacon. All restored.
Idled on the Peak through several waits; Rock back on beacon, all stable. No new ideas.
Several more days idling on the Peak; observed twice, everything stable.
More idling on the Peak; all stable (Rock on Ring atop beacon, staircase intact). No new ideas; if bored try new structures or throwing tests.
New session: observed Peak; all structures stable, nothing new.
Idled on the pillar through two waits; observed once, all stable. No new ideas.
More idle waiting on the pillar; one observe showed all stable. No new ideas.
Idled on the pillar for more waits; one observe showed all stable. No new ideas.
Another stretch of idle waiting on the pillar; observed, all stable. No new ideas.
Session end: idled on the pillar for days; all structures stable; memory updated.
